node.statement: By the allowed validated external lem-stage1-polar-retraction, u_delta(A)=A for every A in calU. Applying this to A=U and A=J, and substituting the equalities of the preceding child into mu(J,U)=u_delta(J bold-dot U), mu(U,J)=u_delta(U bold-dot J), and sigma(J)=u_delta(J^dagger), yields mu(J,U)=mu(U,J)=U and sigma(J)=J. No quantitative correction estimate is asserted or used in this basepoint node.
